cohort: 535 women who underwent cesarean delivery at a hospital in Nigeria between February and April 2019
finding: Robson groups 5, 10, and 1 were the major contributors to the overall cesarean section rate, with previous cesarean section (≥2) and maternal request being the predominant indications for performing cesarean section.
mod_finding: The independent predictors of spinal anesthesia-induced hypotension were the presence of comorbidities and elective cesarean section.
